description: This file defines the TypeORMDriver class for managing Postgres vector store operations, including connection setup, document sanitization, and similarity search integration using TypeORM and pg libraries.

classes.name: TypeORMDriver
classes.description: A driver class for managing Postgres vector store operations with TypeORM, including connection configuration, document management, and similarity search.

methods.name: getPostgresConnectionOptions
methods.description: Asynchronously constructs and returns the Postgres connection options, including credentials and additional configuration.

methods.name: getArgs
methods.description: Returns arguments needed to instantiate the vector store, such as connection options, table name, and schema.

methods.name: instanciate
methods.description: Creates and returns an adapted vector store instance with optional metadata filters.

methods.name: fromDocuments
methods.description: Creates a vector store instance from an array of documents.

methods.name: sanitizeDocuments
methods.description: Removes null characters from document page content to prevent Postgres errors.

methods.name: adaptInstance
methods.description: Modifies a vector store instance to use pg pool connection, with custom similarity search, delete, and add vectors methods.

methods.name: computedOperatorString
methods.description: Determines the distance operator string based on the distance strategy (cosine, innerProduct, euclidean).

methods.name: ensureTableInDatabase
methods.description: Ensures the vector table and pgvector extension exist in the database.

methods.name: similaritySearchVectorWithScore
methods.description: Performs a similarity search with score in the specified table, using a vector query and optional filters.
